video_title: Hawks vs Heat Postgame Press Conference: Nickeil Alexander-Walker

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Atlanta's second-half performance and energy
quotes.excerpt: we're showing that we can compete. Throughout the game, we have to do a better job of consistently competing.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: I know you guys tried to make a few runs in the second half. What do you think was the biggest difference in this one?

text_blocks.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
text_blocks.text: I think it was just a little too late energy-wise. We're showing that we can compete. Throughout the game, we have to do a better job of consistently competing. There's times where our compete level drops, and that's what it was tonight.

quotes.social_post: Nickeil Alexander-Walker says the Hawks were a little too late with their energy against the Heat. He noted that the team needs to do a better job of consistently competing throughout the entire game.

structured.context: Nickeil Alexander-Walker discusses the team's inconsistent energy levels during their loss against the Miami Heat.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on the keys to bouncing back against Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: It's just simple. Really simple. Not a lot of the actions and the O's. Just the small things.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You guys have a quick turnaround, of course, having the opportunity to pick up a win tomorrow night against Cleveland. What will be some things that will be essential to get back on the winning side of things?

text_blocks.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
text_blocks.text: It's just simple. Really simple. Not a lot of the actions and the O's. Just the small things. I think the first two games we really did that really well. Orlando made a run, we responded. How we acted in Charlotte shows the level of competition and the way that we competed at. We set a tone. Tonight, we set a tone throughout the game that gave us a fighting chance. We have to do that, and when we play to our strengths and play to ourselves, we end up giving ourselves a chance to win. I think we have a chance to win when we do those things.

quotes.social_post: Looking ahead to the matchup against Cleveland, Nickeil Alexander-Walker says the key for the Hawks is focusing on the small things rather than complex schemes to get back on the winning side.

structured.context: Nickeil Alexander-Walker explains what the team needs to focus on to improve their performance in the upcoming game against Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Kingston's aggressive play and energy
quotes.excerpt: seeing his mindset, seeing his aggression, the way he competed tonight was amazing.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Nickeil, I'm curious because you've been through so many of the ups and downs of establishing yourself in this league as a younger player. What you thought of Kingston tonight and what you thought of his journey so far?

text_blocks.speaker: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
text_blocks.text: Just work with him every day. Seeing his mindset, seeing his aggression, the way he competed tonight was amazing. And he provided energy. Came in, aggressive, played to his strengths, got the team within striking distance in multiple ways, and his force and everything was amazing.

quotes.social_post: Nickeil Alexander-Walker praised the aggression and energy Kingston brought to the floor tonight, noting that his teammate played to his strengths and helped keep the team within striking distance.

structured.context: Nickeil Alexander-Walker praises his teammate Kingston for his aggressive play and energy during the game.
